spec.description: The {@link EventWindowBinaryClassificationSpec}. That was used to create this {@link EventWindowBinaryScoreResult}.

outcome.description:
Possible outcomes are
- TP: A True Positive is a {@link #monitoredEventWindow} occurs right before a {@link #observedEvent}.
- FP: A False Positive is a {@link #monitoredEventWindow} far from any {@link #observedEvent}s.
- FN: A False Negative is a {@link #monitoredEventWindow} before some {@link #observedEvent}.
Note there is no True Negative because there are no negative events reported.

monitoredEventWindow.description: The {@link MonitoredEventWindow}. If the {@link #outcome} is 'TP' or 'FP', this field should be populated.

observedEvent.description: The {@link ObservedEvent}. If the {@link #outcome} is 'FN' or 'TP', this field should be populated.

title:
Categorizes predicted {@link EventWindow}s as True Positives, False Positives, or False Negatives. See
{@link #outcome} for more details.
name: EventWindowBinaryScoreResult
